title: One agent skill for all of webhooks.cc
items: The agent skill is now called webhooks-cc and covers everything webhooks.cc does: signed test webhooks and signatures, signup emails, mock responses, forwarding, email parsing, tunnels and preview links, teams and approvals
It stays short, so it costs little context in every session, with one reference file per topic for the detail
The Agent skill docs describe the new skill and every way to install it; links to the old webhook-testing files redirect to the new ones
